entries.dialogueText: "My constituents, especially those in Brenas, have expressed concern over the lack of a concrete deadline for the region's return."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We are encouraged by the growing n..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are encouraged by the growing non-violent resistance movement against the Wehzek occupation. Yet we wonder whether it will be enough."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We worry that the growing presence..."
entries.dialogueText: "We worry that the growing presence of Su Omina in Zille, while certainly a thorn in the side of the Wehzek government, risks undermining our goal of a peaceful transfer."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With no agreement in place with We..."
entries.dialogueText: "With no agreement in place with Wehlen and no organized resistance from Zille's Rizian population, we worry that the transfer will be postponed indefinitely."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""A peaceful transfer might be our g..."
entries.dialogueText: "A peaceful transfer might be our goal, but it was never President Smolak's. My party supports the reclamation of Zille by any means necessary."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We are on the same page here, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are on the same page here, Mr. Sazon. There is pressure among my party to take action."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We are on the same page here, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are on the same page here, Mr. Sazon. The pressure on Wehlen must be increased."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""My constituents have expressed con..."
entries.dialogueText: "My constituents have expressed concern over the lack of a concrete deadline for the region's return."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""More to the point, it has alienate..."
entries.dialogueText: "More to the point, it has alienated Rizia's Golcondist population, with whom we were already on shaky ground."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""More to the point, it risks aliena..."
entries.dialogueText: "More to the point, it risks alienating Rizia's Golcondist population, just when we were beginning to better integrate them into our society."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I will say that the process of gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will say that the process of granting rights to Wehzeks has been far from frictionless."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""There have been worries about the..."
entries.dialogueText: "There have been worries about the long-term feasibility of our trade deal. We may not have the resources necessary to hold up our end of the bargain."

entries.dialogueText: "However, I have been fielding concerns that Rizia's participation in Wehlen's 'Operation Bear Trap' is damaging certain lucrative international partnerships."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It is a matter of consistency, Mad..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a matter of consistency, Madame Speaker. It was a mistake to fully integrate Wehzek citizens while restricting rights for other migrant groups."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""However, I have been fielding conc..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I have been fielding concerns that Rizia's so-called Golcondist border ban is damaging certain lucrative international partnerships."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""In essence, it has already pushed..."
entries.dialogueText: "In essence, it has already pushed away Rizia's Golcondist community, a group with whom our relationship was already fragile."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Essentially, it threatens to estra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Essentially, it threatens to estrange Rizia's Golcondist community precisely at the moment we were making progress in integrating them into our society."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The same goes for our border ban,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same goes for our border ban, which has been criticized as unfairly targeting those of Golcondist faith."

entries.dialogueText: "However, some believe that cooperating with Wehlen on the persecution of their Bludish minority has been a bridge too far."

entries.dialogueText: "We are on the same page here, Mr. Sazon. My party is particularly concerned that Rizia's participation in Wehlen's 'Operation Bear Trap' is damaging our lucrative international partnerships."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""More to the point, it has drawn cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "More to the point, it has drawn criticism from certain international partners."

entries.dialogueText: "I will say that agreeing to fully integrate Wehzek citizens while restricting rights for other migrant groups has led to some friction."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Yes, my party has always been of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, my party has always been of the opinion that this term should have been left out of the amended treaty."

entries.title: Narrator: "Daria put up a hand."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Objection. What questions? Zille h..."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That may be true, but in the inter..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be true, but in the interests of stability, reincorporating it under Rizia Imperii's jurisdiction is the obvious choice."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It is the same reason why the Pale..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is the same reason why the Pales Administrative District has not yet rejoined Cardesse-Montaklar."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That decision was due to ongoing b..."
entries.dialogueText: "That decision was due to ongoing border difficulties -- as we have experienced extremely recently. Zille faces no such danger."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That decision was due to ongoing b..."
entries.dialogueText: "That decision was due to ongoing border difficulties. Zille faces no such danger."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The volume in the room grew louder..."
entries.dialogueText: The volume in the room grew louder as the Delegates began arguing among themselves. I turned to Hugo.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have to give Zille back to Brena..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to give Zille back to Brenas, don't I? House Sazon would revolt if I didn't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at them. Squabbling away like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at them. Squabbling away like a bunch of children."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Giving the Sazons more land after..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving the Sazons more land after what they did? They don't deserve it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is totally irrelevant, anyway..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is totally irrelevant, anyway. There's no telling when we'll get Zille back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shouldn't Zille's citizens decide..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shouldn't Zille's citizens decide for themselves who governs them?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You really needn't come to these s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You really needn't come to these sessions, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Don't go down that route, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't go down that route, Your Majesty. Holding any kind of election in Zille opens the door for Wehlen to interfere."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not if the house were sufficiently..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not if the house were sufficiently weakened."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You have empowered the Sazons enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have empowered the Sazons enough without granting them more territory. I beg of you to be careful."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I should say not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should say not."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But with their heir's party holdin..."
entries.dialogueText: "But with their heir's party holding a Delegate majority, the house's demands will only get bolder."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fortunately, you don't have to lis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, you don't have to listen to their demands."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You'll have to make this decision..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have to make this decision sooner or later, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Sooner, one hopes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sooner, one hopes."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""How can you say that after the Fri..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you say that after the Friendship Day incident? There is no telling what Wehlen will do, even if Zille is returned without a fight."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""At this stage, Wehlen will not wan..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this stage, Wehlen will not want to risk damaging our agreement. And if they do, my province can handle it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""*If* Wehlen tries anything, my pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "*If* Wehlen tries anything, my province can handle it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Eventually, Manus motioned for orde..."
entries.dialogueText: Eventually, Manus motioned for order. The Delegates quieted down.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's strategy for reclaiming Zille from Wehlen is a matter of royal confidentiality and not up for debate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hear your concerns. I will do wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear your concerns. I will do what I can to put a flame to Mr. Smolak's feet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Mr. Sazon. I wish we lived in a world where all conflicts could be resolved peacefully. But we do not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hear your concerns. But I cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear your concerns. But I cannot control what is happening outside Rizia's borders."
